title: Stages of Clarity
subtitle: Discerning, Vigilant, Resolute, Enlightened
text: Clarity is the second measure. It cannot be sought directly — it grows as Our Lady speaks and you listen. Discerning (25): the Silver Ward activates, reducing harm from blood-touched sources. Vigilant (50): the ward strengthens, and nearby hemomantic creatures glow at the edges of your sight. Resolute (75): the ward grows stronger still. Enlightened (100): full Silver Ward. She speaks less frequently at this stage. The silence has weight. Do not mistake it for absence.
